summary: Unity Global Trading Sdn. Bhd. (Registration Number: SYN-000029) is an active private limited company in the retail industry located in Selangor, engaged in the retail of textiles and baju kurung, with a share capital of 250,000. The company is managed by five directors (Director 1 as Managing Director, Director 2 as Independent Director, Director 3 as Director, Director 4 as Director, and Director 5 as Executive Director, appointed across various dates between 2021 and 2025) and owned by four shareholders (Director 4 holding 58.25%, Director 5 holding 21.22%, Director 1 holding 12.21%, and Director 3 holding 8.32%). Over the three financial years from 2022 to 2024, the company recorded revenues of 5,130,131 (FY2022), 5,229,803 (FY2023), and 5,352,856 (FY2024), with net profits after tax of 113,910, 97,951, and 96,805 respectively, all receiving unqualified audit opinions from Audit Firm 8. There are currently 0 litigation cases recorded against the company.
